meta.title: A11Y Checker - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Check off the 16 WCAG items one by one, track your progress in real time, and generate an inspection report with one click.
desc: Check off the 16 WCAG items one by one, track your progress in real time, and generate an inspection report with one click.
ui.15: Content remains fully readable and functional at 200% browser zoom
ui.17: Overflowing areas are scrollable with visible scrollbars and keyboard scrolling
ui.19: Color is not the only way to convey information; icons or text are used as well
ui.21: Form errors are associated with their input fields and include fix suggestions
ui.23: Clickable targets are at least 44x44px with sufficient spacing between them
ui.25: Videos have captions; audio has transcripts or transcribed text
ui.27: prefers-reduced-motion is supported to respect users' preference for reduced motion
ui.30: Page headings follow h1 to h6 order without skipping levels or misusing them
ui.32: Every input control has an associated visible label or aria-label
ui.34: All img elements have descriptive alt attributes; decorative images use empty alt
ui.36: Icon buttons without text have an accessible name such as aria-label
ui.38: Focus indicator is clearly visible when tabbing and not hidden or covered by styles
ui.40: All interactive elements (links, buttons, forms) can be operated using only the keyboard
ui.42: Semantic elements such as header/main/nav/footer/article are used to structure the page
ui.44: Text-to-background contrast ratio is at least 4.5:1, and 3:1 for large text
